import argparse

from dataclasses import dataclass, field

RouterFn = Callable[
    [str, List[str], List[dict]],
    Tuple[str, str],
]

DEATH_SCORE = -100.0


@dataclass
class EvalConfig:

class StepRecord:

    done: bool

    oracle = {}
